name: Halberd

name: Lance

name: Longsword

name: Maul

name: Morningstar
lore: A spiked metal head on a long haft.

name: Pike

name: Rapier

name: Scimitar

name: Shortsword

name: Trident

name: Crossbow, heavy

name: Longbow

name: Net

name: Padded Armor

name: Scale Mail
lore: Scale mail consists of overlapping metal scales sewn onto a leather backing.

name: Breastplate

name: Ring Mail

name: Chain Mail
lore: Chain mail is made of interlocking metal rings and includes a layer of padding worn underneath.

name: Splint Armor

name: Plate Armor

name: Adamantine Armor
lore: This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine, one of the hardest substances in existence, turning critical hits into normal hits.

name: Mithral Armor
lore: Mithral is a light, flexible metal that reduces the weight and stealth penalty of medium or heavy armor.

name: Elven Chain
lore: This finely wrought chain shirt is light enough to be worn under clothing and grants a +1 bonus to AC.

name: Glamoured Studded Leather
lore: This studded leather armor can be commanded to assume the appearance of normal clothing or another suit of armor.

name: Armor of Invulnerability
lore: This plate armor grants resistance to nonmagical damage and can temporarily make the wearer immune to such harm.

name: Demon Armor
lore: This plate armor is inscribed with demonic runes and grants a +1 bonus to AC while cursing the wearer.

name: Dwarven Plate
lore: This plate armor is crafted by dwarves and offers a +2 bonus to AC while reducing forced movement.

name: Plate Armor of Etherealness
lore: This plate armor allows the wearer to enter the Ethereal Plane.

name: Shield of Missile Attraction
lore: This shield attracts ranged weapon attacks, imposing disadvantage on attacks against other targets.

name: Animated Shield
lore: This shield can animate to defend you on its own, leaving your hand free.

name: Spellguard Shield
lore: This shield grants advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

name: Potion of Healing
lore: A red liquid that glimmers when agitated, this potion restores a small amount of hit points.

name: Potion of Climbing
lore: When you drink this potion, you gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
lore: This stronger red draught mends serious wounds in a single gulp.

name: Potion of Water Breathing
lore: This cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.

name: Potion of Animal Friendship
lore: A draught that lets you charm nearby beasts into treating you as a trusted friend.

name: Potion of Fire Breath
lore: This orange liquid flickers, and smoke fills the container whenever it is opened.

name: Potion of Poison
lore: This concoction looks, smells, and tastes like a healing potion but is actually poison masked by illusion magic.

name: Potion of Resistance
lore: When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to one type of damage for 1 hour.

name: Potion of Growth
lore: The red in this potion's liquid continuously expands and contracts, granting the enlarge effect.

name: Philter of Love
lore: This potion's pink, effervescent liquid causes the drinker to be charmed by the first creature they see.

name: Potion of Hill Giant Strength
lore: This potion's transparent liquid has a bead of giant strength floating in it.

name: Potion of Diminution
lore: This potion shrinks you dramatically for a time, allowing you to slip through gaps.

name: Potion of Gaseous Form
lore: This potion's container seems to hold fog that moves and pours like water.

name: Potion of Heroism
lore: This blue potion bubbles and steams as if boiling, granting vigor and courage.

name: Potion of Invisibility
lore: This potion's container looks empty but feels as though it holds liquid.

name: Potion of Clairvoyance
lore: A draught that lets you magically see or hear a distant location for a time.

name: Potion of Mind Reading
lore: This potion's dense, purple liquid has an ovoid cloud of pink floating in it.

name: Potion of Invulnerability
lore: This potion's syrupy liquid looks like liquefied iron and grants resistance to all damage.

name: Potion of Frost Giant Strength
lore: This potion's transparent liquid has a bead of frost giant strength floating in it.

name: Potion of Stone Giant Strength
lore: This potion's transparent liquid has a bead of stone giant strength floating in it.

name: Potion of Fire Giant Strength
lore: This potion's transparent liquid has a bead of fire giant strength floating in it.

name: Potion of Superior Healing
lore: A high-grade healing draught that mends grievous wounds in one gulp.

name: Potion of Speed
lore: This solution ripples and splashes of its own accord, almost like it's trying to escape the bottle.

name: Potion of Flying
lore: When you drink this potion, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour and can hover.

name: Potion of Cloud Giant Strength
lore: This potion's transparent liquid has a bead of cloud giant strength floating in it.

name: Potion of Longevity
lore: This potion's clear liquid has a single drop of light swirling in it, reducing the drinker's age.

name: Potion of Vitality
lore: A powerful restorative that removes exhaustion and disease and maximizes your healing.

name: Potion of Supreme Healing
lore: The strongest of the standard healing potions, mending even grievous wounds in a single gulp.

name: Potion of Storm Giant Strength
lore: This potion's transparent liquid has a bead of storm giant strength floating in it.

name: Spell Scroll (Cantrip)

consumable_effect.note: Casts a cantrip of the creator's choice

lore: A scroll bearing the mystical cipher of a cantrip, readable by those who have it on their spell list.

name: Spell Scroll (1st Level)

consumable_effect.note: Casts a 1st-level spell of the creator's choice

lore: A scroll holding the words of a 1st-level spell, written in a mystical cipher.

name: Spell Scroll (2nd Level)

consumable_effect.note: Casts a 2nd-level spell of the creator's choice

lore: A scroll containing a 2nd-level spell, its magic sealed within a mystical cipher.

name: Spell Scroll (3rd Level)

consumable_effect.note: Casts a 3rd-level spell of the creator's choice

name: Spell Scroll (4th Level)

consumable_effect.note: Casts a 4th-level spell of the creator's choice

name: Spell Scroll (5th Level)

consumable_effect.note: Casts a 5th-level spell of the creator's choice

name: Spell Scroll (6th Level)

consumable_effect.note: Casts a 6th-level spell of the creator's choice

lore: A very rare scroll inscribed with a 6th-level spell, its magic difficult to decipher.

name: Spell Scroll (7th Level)

consumable_effect.note: Casts a 7th-level spell of the creator's choice

lore: A very rare scroll containing a 7th-level spell, its cipher complex and its power formidable.

name: Spell Scroll (8th Level)

consumable_effect.note: Casts an 8th-level spell of the creator's choice

lore: A very rare scroll bearing an 8th-level spell, its magical cipher nearly impossible to break.

name: Spell Scroll (9th Level)

consumable_effect.note: Casts a 9th-level spell of the creator's choice

lore: A legendary scroll inscribed with a 9th-level spell, a treasure of immense magical power.

name: Abacus

name: Acid (vial)

consumable_effect.note: Thrown vial shatters, splashing acid on the target

lore: A vial of corrosive green liquid that burns flesh and metal alike.

name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)

consumable_effect.note: Target takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of each turn until extinguished

lore: A sticky, flammable fluid that ignites upon contact with air.

name: Antitoxin (vial)

consumable_effect.note: Grants advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour

lore: A small vial of bitter serum that neutralizes toxins in the bloodstream.

name: Arcane focus

name: Arrows (20)

name: Backpack

name: Barrel

name: Bedroll

name: Bell

name: Blanket

name: Block and tackle

name: Blowgun needles (50)

name: Dice set

name: Druidic focus

name: Entertainer's pack

name: Explorer's pack

name: Fishing tackle

name: Flask or tankard

lore: A small leather or cloth bag for holding coins or small items.

name: Quiver
lore: A leather container for holding arrows or crossbow bolts.

name: Rope, hempen (50 feet)

name: Rope, silk (50 feet)
lore: A light, strong rope woven from silk fibers.

lore: A simple cloth bag for carrying loot or supplies.

name: Scale, merchant's
lore: A balance scale with weights for measuring goods.

name: Sealing wax
lore: A stick of wax used to seal letters and documents.

name: Shovel
lore: A tool for digging earth or snow.

name: Signal whistle
lore: A small whistle that produces a sharp, far-reaching sound.

name: Signet ring
lore: A ring engraved with a personal or family seal.

name: Sling bullets (20)
lore: Twenty lead pellets for use with a sling.

name: Soap
lore: A bar of lye soap for washing.

name: Spellbook
lore: A leather-bound tome with blank pages for recording spells.

name: Spikes, iron (10)
lore: Ten iron spikes for wedging doors shut or anchoring ropes.

name: Spyglass

consumable_effect.note: Objects viewed through the spyglass are magnified to twice their size

lore: A brass tube with lenses that magnifies distant objects.

name: Tent, two-person
lore: A canvas shelter large enough for two people.

name: Thieves' tools

consumable_effect.note: Required to pick locks or disarm traps

lore: A set of files, picks, pliers, and other tools for picking locks and disarming traps.

name: Tinderbox

consumable_effect.note: Used to light torches, lamps, or campfires

lore: A small box containing flint, steel, and tinder for starting fires.

name: Torch

consumable_effect.note: Can be used as an improvised weapon

lore: A wooden stick with a flammable head that burns brightly.

name: Vial
lore: A small glass container for holding liquids.

name: Waterskin
lore: A leather pouch for carrying water, holding about four pints.

name: Whetstone
lore: A stone for sharpening blades.

name: Longsword +1
lore: A finely balanced longsword etched with faint runes that guide the wielder’s hand.

name: Longsword +2
lore: The runes on this blade glow with a steady blue light, sharpening the edge beyond mortal craft.

name: Longsword +3
lore: A masterwork longsword whose runes pulse with golden light, nearly unbreakable and guided by destiny.

name: Battleaxe +1
lore: The axe’s head is inlaid with silver runes that hum softly when danger is near.

name: Battleaxe +2
lore: This battleaxe’s edge never dulls, and its haft is wrapped in enchanted leather that improves grip.

name: Battleaxe +3
lore: A legendary war‑axe whose runes flare with each strike, cleaving through armor and bone alike.

name: Dagger +1
lore: A slim blade that seems to find its target on its own, its pommel set with a tiny opal.

name: Dagger +2
lore: This dagger’s edge is so fine that it leaves no trace, and its magic guides the hand of the assassin.

name: Dagger +3
lore: A blade of legend, said to have been forged from a fallen star, it never misses its mark.

name: Shortbow +1
lore: The bow’s string glows faintly, and arrows loosed from it fly truer than any mundane shaft.

name: Shortbow +2
lore: This bow is carved with hunting runes that whisper to the wind, extending the range of each shot.

name: Shortbow +3
lore: A legendary bow whose arrows are said to never miss, its runes blazing with emerald fire.

name: Flame Tongue

name: Frost Brand
lore: This blade is sheathed in eternal ice, and its touch can freeze a foe’s blood.

name: Sun Blade
lore: This hilt produces a blade of pure sunlight when drawn, burning undead with holy radiance.

name: Vorpal Sword
lore: A terrifying greatsword whose edge is so sharp that it can decapitate a foe in a single stroke.

name: Ring of Protection

name: Ring of Invisibility

name: Ring of Spell Turning

name: Rod of Lordly Might
lore: This rod can transform into a mace, a battleaxe, a spear, or a climbing pole, and it has other magical powers.

name: Staff of the Magi

name: Staff of Charming

name: Wand of Magic Missiles

name: Wand of Fireballs
lore: This wand can unleash explosive fireballs, and it regains charges each dawn.

name: Bag of Holding
lore: This bag’s interior is larger than its exterior, holding up to 500 pounds of gear in a extradimensional space.

name: Boots of Elvenkind
lore: These soft boots muffle the wearer’s footsteps, granting advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

name: Cloak of Displacement

name: Broom of Flying

name: Ring of Protection
lore: This platinum ring is set with a diamond, and it grants a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws.

lore: While wearing this ring, you can turn invisible as an action, remaining so until you attack or cast a spell.

name: Ring of Spell Turning
lore: This ring reflects certain spells back at their caster, turning their own magic against them.

name: Immovable Rod
lore: This flat iron rod can be fixed in place with a command, holding up to 8,000 pounds of weight.

name: Rod of Lordly Might
lore: This rod can transform into a mace, a battleaxe, a spear, or a climbing pole, and it has other magical powers.

name: Staff of the Magi
lore: A powerful staff that can absorb spells, cast many spells, and even break upon command in a retributive explosion.

name: Staff of Charming
lore: This staff can cast charm person and other enchantments, and it grants advantage on saving throws against being charmed.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles
lore: This wand has 7 charges and can fire magic missiles, regaining charges at dawn.

name: Wand of Fireballs
lore: This wand can unleash explosive fireballs, and it regains charges each dawn.

name: Bag of Holding
lore: This bag’s interior is larger than its exterior, holding up to 500 pounds of gear in a extradimensional space.

name: Boots of Elvenkind
lore: These soft boots muffle the wearer’s footsteps, granting advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

name: Cloak of Displacement
lore: This cloak projects an illusion that makes the wearer appear to be a few feet away from their actual position, imposing disadvantage on attacks against them.

name: Broom of Flying
lore: This wooden broom can be commanded to fly, carrying up to 400 pounds at a speed of 50 feet.
